hypotheses.scientific_question: Does historical BTC return volatility exhibit statistically significant autoregressive clustering across quarterly regimes?
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Historical BTC returns exhibit independent and identically distributed variance with zero autoregressive persistence (ARCH coefficient = 0).
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Historical BTC return variance exhibits significant volatility clustering (ARCH effect p < 0.01).
hypotheses.effect_definition: Lag-1 autoregressive coefficient of squared returns
hypotheses.retrospective_justification: Historical prospective preregistration record prior to 2024 observation period is unverified.
